A '''spore bomb''' was a weapon created by [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] terrorist [[Ort Hoogra-D'En]]. He used it to spread bioweapons he created from various plant spores. He set off 5 bombs, including one that [[Death/Legends|killed]] 45 people at the [[Bombing of Syndaar Military Prep School]].

It used [[tamack]] spores to spread a highly infectious disease. Infection happened almost immediately, and death usually occurred in a few hours. The disease was spread by contact or inhalation, and was treatable through total [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] immersion. It had a blast radius of 40 meters.
